messages:
tasha: Quick a11y pass on Query Insights table in console. Noticed focus outline disappears on row click and sortable headers have no aria-sort. Prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Need quick wins before next deploy.

eli: saw this. table rows are implemented as <div role="row"> and cells as <div role="gridcell">. That part's ok, but keyboard doesn't move between rows with arrow keys. Data-grid behavior expected by screen readers is missing.

jon: agree. Recommend using role="grid" on the container and handling arrow key navigation. For sortable headers add aria-sort="none|ascending|descending" and update on click.

aria-bot: scan results: 5 contrast fails (label tokens: ui-muted, ui-muted-weak), 2 missing aria attributes (headers), 1 focusable element without name. See attached report.

kevin: small contrast sample: 'Active' pill uses #7f7f7f on #ffffff -> ratio ~3.0. Should be >=4.5 for normal text or at least 3:1 for large UI components. Prefer switching to token text-600 (#2f2f2f) for pills.

lina: I'm happy to take the PR. Plan:
1) swap failing tokens to text-600
2) add role="grid" + keyboard handlers for arrow navigation
3) set aria-sort on header buttons
4) ensure any icon-only buttons have aria-label
I'll flag behind feature flag and include tests.

tasha: also a nit: focus order currently sends keyboard from table to an unrelated page-level button — we likely need to set correct tabindex or refocus management. Repro in Safari + VoiceOver.

eli: for focus styling propose consistent token:
```
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }
```
and for rows add aria-selected when active.

jon: add aria-live="polite" to the summary region that updates with filter counts so screen readers get updates.

lina: will include a QA checklist in the PR: contrast screenshots, NVDA/VO smoke tests, keyboard-only walkthrough, automated axe pass locally.

tasha: thanks — can you estimate time? we want this in the next sprint.

lina: first draft PR today, follow-up review tomorrow. tagging @kevin for design token approval.

kevin: approved for token swaps. :+1:

aria-bot: scan re-run queued once PR deploys to staging.
